player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ee game de GameOfPureStrategy.
- Yin ee kareem 13 kaad A-K; kareem juëc ëbën.
- Këlaa round kaad prize ee gɔ̈ɔ̈r. Dhiëth kaad tök ee kuɛ̈t kaad bracketed token ka ye '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kaad kɔ̈k aye kaad prize (plus carry-over). Tie aye kaad prize ee pot ëbën round ë diɛ̈ɛ̈r.
- Yin ee kareem tök aye 13 round aye kaad yin.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kë cï looi adhil naŋ kë tök në kaar de kä ye kek mat yiic.

message.tie: {observation}Kënnë ee lääu ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈k -> kuɛ̈ɛ̈k ee {carry_pot}.
